system.story: The unlicensed neighborhood doctor who patches gangers and edgerunners for cash and favors.

description.value:
Subclass: Street-Doc. The resourceful, improvisational back-alley generalist - wired into the street.

Role Feature - Make Do

You improvise and restock Reagents faster and cheaper (scavenged materials, black-market stock), and your Field Synthesis is stronger - the medic who never quite runs dry. The best kit-economy of the three.

Signature Tweak

First Aid works at an edge on the badly wounded - you do your best work when it is worst.

Bonus Skill & Contact

A streetwise/contacts skill, plus a fixer, ganger-clinic, or black-market-pharma contact.

Corp Records

Unlicensed - flagged.
